name: figma
description: Figma: read files, pages, frames, the text in designs and comments. Read only: it changes nothing in Figma. Needs a personal access token.

tools.name: figma_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Figma connection (access token) and show who the token belongs to. Read only.

tools.name: figma_list_project_files
tools.description: List the files of a Figma project. Read only.

tools.name: figma_get_file_outline
tools.description: Show the pages of a file and the top-level frames on each. Read only.

tools.name: figma_read_frame_text
tools.description: Read the text in up to 10 frames, grouped by frame. Read only.

tools.name: figma_list_comments
tools.description: List the comment threads of a file with replies and the frame each sits on. Read only.

figma_token.title: Personal access token
figma_token.description: Figma, Settings, Security, Personal access tokens, Generate new token. Give it read scopes only: File content (read), Comments (read), Projects (read). Stored as a secret.
